description: DARAMS experiment reporting dashboard for A/B, selector matrix, cost, and model_pool decisions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_id, run_name, run_type, is_official, status, data_source, start_date, end_date, report_path, source_report_dir, completed_at, ingested_at FROM experiment_runs WHERE run_id = '$run_id'

SELECT strategy, NULLIF(variant_name, '') AS variant, scenario_name, is_benchmark, rank_by_net_return, cumulative_return_pct, annualized_return_pct, sharpe, max_drawdown_pct, win_rate_pct, avg_turnover, avg_gross_return_bps, avg_total_cost_bps, avg_net_return_bps, n_retrains, n_pool_reuses, n_pool_misses FROM experiment_strategy_results WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY is_benchmark, COALESCE(rank_by_net_return, 999), strategy, variant_name, scenario_name

SELECT trade_date AS time, strategy || CASE WHEN variant_name <> '' THEN '/' || variant_name ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN scenario_name <> 'baseline' THEN '/' || scenario_name ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN is_benchmark THEN ' (benchmark)' ELSE '' END AS metric, cumulative_value AS value FROM experiment_daily_pnl WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY time, metric

SELECT trade_date AS time, strategy || CASE WHEN variant_name <> '' THEN '/' || variant_name ELSE '' END || ' gross' AS metric, gross_return * 10000.0 AS value FROM experiment_daily_pnl WHERE run_id = '$run_id' UNION ALL SELECT trade_date AS time, strategy || CASE WHEN variant_name <> '' THEN '/' || variant_name ELSE '' END || ' cost' AS metric, -1.0 * (COALESCE(commission_cost, 0) + COALESCE(tax_cost, 0) + COALESCE(slippage_cost, 0)) * 10000.0 AS value FROM experiment_daily_pnl WHERE run_id = '$run_id' UNION ALL SELECT trade_date AS time, strategy || CASE WHEN variant_name <> '' THEN '/' || variant_name ELSE '' END || ' net' AS metric, net_return * 10000.0 AS value FROM experiment_daily_pnl WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY time, metric

SELECT trade_date AS time, strategy || CASE WHEN variant_name <> '' THEN '/' || variant_name ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN scenario_name <> 'baseline' THEN '/' || scenario_name ELSE '' END AS metric, turnover AS value FROM experiment_daily_pnl WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND is_benchmark = false ORDER BY time, metric

SELECT COALESCE(selected_role, 'unknown') AS selected_role, COUNT(*) AS selected_count FROM experiment_model_pool_decisions WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND selected IS TRUE GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY selected_count DESC

SELECT date, NULLIF(variant_name, '') AS variant, candidate_role, selected_role, selected, decision_reason, candidate_similarity, selected_similarity, best_seen_similarity, selection_metric, selection_score, shadow_topk_net_return, proxy_net_return, proxy_cost, proxy_rank_by_net FROM experiment_model_pool_decisions WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY date, variant_name, selected DESC, candidate_role

SELECT variant_name, selection_metric, similarity_threshold, cumulative_return_pct, sharpe, max_drawdown_pct, avg_net_return_bps, avg_total_cost_bps, n_retrains, n_pool_reuses, n_pool_misses, selected_current, selected_new, selected_reused, selected_proxy_rank_mean FROM experiment_strategy_results WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND is_matrix_cell = true ORDER BY cumulative_return_pct DESC

SELECT scenario_name, round_trip_cost_pct, strategy, rank_by_net_return, cumulative_return_pct, sharpe, max_drawdown_pct, avg_turnover, avg_total_cost_bps, avg_net_return_bps FROM experiment_strategy_results WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND scenario_name <> 'baseline' ORDER BY round_trip_cost_pct, rank_by_net_return, strategy
